sample: 2017-2025 regular-season games with archived closing lines (third-party archive)

legs.pair: favourite covers the spread vs game goes over the total
legs.method: phi coefficient on binary outcomes; positive means the two legs co-move
legs.interpretation: near zero: pricing a same-game parlay of these two legs by multiplication is approximately correct on this sample, but the sign/size must be re-measured per game.

legs.pair: home win vs game goes over the total
legs.interpretation: near zero; no measured dependence on this sample.

residual_persistence.method: correlation of consecutive-season mean own-vs-actual spread error
residual_persistence.interpretation: If this is not clearly positive, the model's spread error has no season-to-season memory, i.e. what looks like edge in one season does not carry into the next. This is the anti-luck test that matters for a leaderboard.

not_measured.pair: QB passing yards vs WR1 receiving yards (same game)
not_measured.reason: requires official player-game logs and prop prices; neither is in this repository in an authorised form. Left blank rather than copied from a peer estimate (flag F-02).
